A '''subterranean facility''' was one of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] prison structures in the [[abandoned Rakata machine chamber]] in [[the Tomb]], an ancient Rakata [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. When the [[Esh-kha]] were released from imprisonment, Esh-kha troops under the leadership of [[Hunter Moon]] took over the facility and turned it into an interrogation chamber, where they tortured the captured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Chayloss]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Esh-kha interrogation chamber is a location in the Tomb on the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and the site of the Republic mission "Striking the Esh-kha."<ref name="TOR" />
